anchors.name: article
anchors.description: Journalistic articles, blog posts, magazine pieces, and news stories. Reports on people, events, or topics with a byline and publication venue. Not academically structured.

anchors.name: cooking
anchors.description: Cookbooks and recipe collections. Contains ingredient lists, quantities, preparation steps, cooking times, temperatures, and yields.

anchors.name: correspondence
anchors.description: Letters, formal emails, memos, and written communications between named parties. Has an identifiable sender, recipient, date, and subject or message body.

anchors.name: fiction
anchors.description: Prose fiction including novels, short stories, novellas, and narrative writing. Contains characters, dialogue, scenes, and a plot. Not journalism or non-fiction.

anchors.name: finance
anchors.description: Financial documents such as bills, invoices, receipts, bank statements, credit card statements, tax forms, and expense reports. Contains monetary amounts, account numbers, billing periods, and due dates.

anchors.name: gamedev
anchors.description: Video game development and the games industry. Content about gameplay mechanics, level design for players, enemy AI and boss encounters, quest and mission structure, combat systems, hitboxes and collision detection, respawn and checkpoint logic, playtesting notes, game genres (RPG, FPS, platformer, roguelike), publisher relationships, monetization, and postmortems on shipped titles.

anchors.name: legal
anchors.description: Legally binding or legally significant documents: contracts, agreements, terms of service, end-user license agreements, deeds, powers of attorney, wills, and corporate filings. Formal language with defined parties and clauses.

anchors.name: personal
anchors.description: Personal records, private correspondence, identification numbers, account credentials, health documentation, and other material that pertains specifically to the individual's life and is not meant for public sharing.

anchors.name: reference
anchors.description: Reference material and technical documentation: user manuals, developer documentation, specifications, cheat sheets, product guides, and how-to instructions. Meant to be consulted rather than read straight through.

anchors.name: research
anchors.description: Peer-reviewed academic or scientific research paper. Contains an abstract summarizing findings, hypothesis or research question, methodology or experimental protocol, results with data or mathematical proofs, discussion of implications, and a bibliography citing prior work. Includes journal articles, conference proceedings, arxiv preprints, dissertations, and technical reports from research institutions.

anchors.name: ai
anchors.description: Artificial intelligence: neural networks, deep learning architectures, model training, reinforcement learning, computer vision, natural language processing, and AI applications across domains.

anchors.name: api documentation
anchors.description: Software API reference documentation: endpoint specifications, request and response formats, authentication requirements, rate limits, error codes, and usage examples.

anchors.name: contract
anchors.description: Signed or draft contracts: employment agreements, service contracts, non-disclosure agreements, lease agreements, and other bilateral or multilateral agreements with named parties.

anchors.name: electronics
anchors.description: Electronic engineering: analog and digital circuits, schematics, PCB design, components (resistors, capacitors, transistors, integrated circuits), embedded systems, microcontrollers, and signal processing.

anchors.name: engineering
anchors.description: Engineering disciplines: mechanical, electrical, civil, aerospace, or chemical. Design analysis, materials selection, load calculations, industry standards, and safety codes.

anchors.name: fanfiction
anchors.description: Fan-created fiction based on existing franchises, series, characters, or settings. Includes crossovers, alternate universes, self-inserts, and character-focused narrative writing.

anchors.name: game development
anchors.description: Game development topics beyond any specific engine: gameplay programming, game design theory, level design, procedural generation, game AI, and industry practices.

anchors.name: hardware
anchors.description: Computer hardware and hardware architecture: CPUs, GPUs, memory hierarchies, storage devices, motherboards, peripherals, and processor microarchitecture.

anchors.name: hobby electronics
anchors.description: Hobbyist electronics and maker projects: Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32, homebrew circuits, DIY projects, breadboard prototyping, and 3D-printed enclosures.

anchors.name: llms
anchors.description: Large language models specifically: transformer architectures, tokenization, attention mechanisms, pretraining and fine-tuning, RLHF, prompting techniques, and inference optimization.

anchors.name: machine learning
anchors.description: Classical machine learning: supervised and unsupervised methods, feature engineering, model evaluation metrics, cross-validation, decision trees, SVMs, clustering, and dimensionality reduction.

anchors.name: manual
anchors.description: Product or software user manuals: installation instructions, operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, safety warnings, and specifications for a specific product.

anchors.name: mathematics
anchors.description: Mathematics: algebra, calculus, geometry, number theory, combinatorics, statistics, linear algebra, differential equations, and formal proofs with theorems and derivations.

anchors.name: medical
anchors.description: Medical records: prescriptions, lab results, doctor's notes, insurance claims, immunization records, imaging reports, and health-related paperwork.

anchors.name: networking
anchors.description: Computer networking: TCP/IP, routing protocols, switching, wireless standards (WiFi, Bluetooth, cellular), network security, DNS, VPNs, and network architecture.

anchors.name: physics
anchors.description: Physics topics including classical mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, optics, relativity, quantum mechanics, particle physics, and astrophysics. Mathematical treatment of physical phenomena.

anchors.name: programming
anchors.description: Software development in any language: source code, algorithms, data structures, libraries, frameworks, build systems, and programming language reference material.

anchors.name: recipe
anchors.description: An individual cooking recipe or small recipe collection. Includes an ingredient list with quantities, step-by-step preparation, cooking time, and yield or servings.

anchors.name: recovery codes
anchors.description: Multi-factor authentication backup codes, one-time recovery codes, or account recovery keys for online services. Typically a list of short alphanumeric strings.

anchors.name: specification
anchors.description: Formal technical specifications and standards documents: RFCs, ISO standards, IEEE standards, W3C recommendations, and similar normative reference material with precise language.

anchors.name: tax
anchors.description: Tax documents and tax-related material: tax returns, W-2s, 1099s, receipts for deductions, tax planning notes, and correspondence with tax authorities.
